role: Provisional next-training seed: strongest tested guarded AMP candidate; original 1799 and 1499 retained.
method: 100 PPO updates, AMP plus pose guidance, leg-output-only adaptation, sampled braking action constraint 0.01rad.
reference: Corrected sprint1/subject2 only; licensed motion stays local.

evaluation.gait: Very small measured leg-pose changes; no claim of human-like running yet.

limitations: Small simulation improvement across two cohorts, not a statistical or hardware robustness guarantee.
The braking bound covers calibration and recent sampled observations, not all possible states.
AMP whole-body discriminator is sensitive to fixed arm mismatch; next experiment isolates locomotion features.
